verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound webhook callbacks for task, run or session completion. The only status mechanism shown is polling `runs.events()` with a cursor, which is the approach the story wants to replace. Webhooks are a fair axis for a cloud agent and browser API, so this is "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As a developer, I can get webhook notifications when tasks and sessions finish instead of polling for status
